secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server hostname for real email delivery (e.g. smtp.gmail.com, smtp.zoho.com). Optional: without it, mail is captured by the local Mailpit inbox.

secrets.name: SMTP_PORT
secrets.description: SMTP port: 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for implicit SSL.

secrets.name: SMTP_USER
secrets.description: SMTP username (usually the full email address of the sending mailbox).

secrets.name: SMTP_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP password or app password for the sending mailbox.

secrets.name: SMTP_SECURE
secrets.description: TLS mode: "tls" for STARTTLS (port 587), "ssl" for implicit TLS (port 465), or leave empty for plain.

secrets.name: MAIL_FROM
secrets.description: From address for outgoing mail, e.g. no-reply@yourdomain.com — must be allowed by your SMTP provider.
